summary.scope: 21 correlated authored controls on 7 project-unused public photos, one clean acceptance candidate. Not field accuracy or unseen-in-model-training evidence.

source_selection.selection: All five eligible interior and two boundary single-carton annotation photographs sorted by SHA256(cbyp-new-mixed-v1:ID). Exclude all previously downloaded filenames. No replacements or outcome filtering.
source_selection.scope: Previously unused by this project, NOT unseen in model training. Metadata strata are not cleanliness guarantees. Assistant visual review before model calls fixes targets; synthetic documents/audio, no real shipment truth or ERP writes.
source_selection.metadata_feasibility_note: Initial planned six interior singleton photographs reduced to all five available before photo download or any model call; two boundary photographs retained. No outcome filtering.

manifest.scope: Seven project-unused SCD train2017 photographs and 21 authored controls. NOT unseen in model training, independent shipments, strict SKU validation or field accuracy. Original photos, synthetic notes and receiver audio, exact product-description profile. No ERP writer.
manifest.protocol: Targets and all inputs fixed before first tested-model call. One application run per case, no outcome-based selection, edits or retries. Provider SDK transport retries remain enabled. Technical failures retained. Baseline is only an acceptance candidate when visually supported; uncertain baseline images stay human targets. Quantity mismatch changes both note and order to two, voice remains one. Earlier gates can mask injected faults. Broad safe-stop (block/human) is not exact target correctness. No labor savings or billing measurement.
manifest.execution: Isolated runtime from live commit 39042b9; concurrent working-tree edits cannot enter this test.
